== Building a ship ==

A ship's hull only determines the starting platform. Its actual capabilities depend heavily on its modules and Engineering.

For build planning, see:

* [[Ship Builds]]
* [[Outfitting]]
* [[Engineering]]
* [[Engineering Blueprints]]

{{Field note|The most expensive ship is not automatically the best ship for a particular activity. Landing-pad size, internal compartments, hardpoints, handling, jump capability, module compatibility, and the intended build can matter more than hull price.}}
